page.overview:
What is Kyber crystal building?

The power to build with kyber crystals was a rare Force power known only to the Jedi Master Baird Kantoo who used the power to forge the Kyber Saber. He locked the secret away in a holocron inside a temple on an planet. Rowan Freemaker eventually found the holocron after passing the challenges of the temple and after he learned the power from the holocron used it to forge the kyber crystal necessary for his starship the Arrowhead.

This lead to Rowan and Naare hunting for many Kyber Crystals, until Rowan found out about Naare's true identity where they raced to find the crystals. Naare kept stealing the crystals from them, until Rowan found one on Hoth. Needing to escape, Rowan created a plan so he, his sister Kordi, his brother Zander Freemaker, and RO-GR surrendered a piece of ice to Naare, tricking her into trying to forge the Kyber Saber, only for the ice to melt and the Freemakers to escape.

Palpatine grew furious at the Kyber Saber's disappearance and so built a hunter droid, M-OC to hunt down Rowan Freemaker, so that he could reveal where the Kyber Saber was.

This lead Rowan to find many pieces to construct the Arrowhead, eventually crash landing on the planet where Baird Kantoo had left his holocron millennia ago. Following a series of challenges inside the temple he learned from the holocron and created the kyber crystal necessary to power the Arrowheads shields. and became a great success for the Rebellion.
